own.claim: When a programme sends an interview invitation with a short booking window, the founder should book within one business day to signal seriousness and to avoid the slot being filled by another applicant
own.why: Programmes often release slots on a first-come basis, and a delay of even one day can result in no availability by Friday

own.claim: Programmes that are not in the founder's active tracking system are often ones the founder applied to without full coordination, or ones that were added to the pipeline after the brief was last updated
own.why: A founder's brief is the source of truth for what is in motion; an application outside it suggests a gap in process

own.claim: Before booking an interview slot, the founder should know the programme's format, the questions it typically asks, and what has changed in the company since the application was submitted
own.why: An unprepared interview is a wasted slot and a missed signal to the programme

own.claim: A programme that invites to interview without a prior status update — no 'under review' mail, no eligibility check — may indicate a rolling intake rather than a cohort, which changes the timeline and the decision process
own.why: Rolling programmes decide faster and may have already made a preliminary decision before the interview; cohort programmes read all applications together
